releases.title: Vobile Signs Strategic Cooperation and Commercial Agreements with UNN to Build AI Factories in Brunei Darussalam
releases.body:
SANTA CLARA, Calif., Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vobile, a global leader in digital content protection and transaction services, has signed strategic cooperation and commercial agreements with Unified National Networks Sdn Bhd (UNN), an integrated national telecommunication network operator of Brunei Darussalam.

Christopher Phan, Acting Chief Executive Officer of UNN, and Yangbin Wang, Chief Executive Officer of Vobile, Inc., signed the agreements at a ceremony held at UNN's Tungku Submarine Cable Landing Station on September 3, 2026. The ceremony was witnessed by Yang Mulia Haji Hairul Mohd Daud bin Haji Abd Karim, Deputy Permanent Secretary (Infocommunications), Ministry of Transport and Infocommunications, and UNN Board Director.

"The development of AI-ready infrastructure is of critical importance, not only for our two organizations but also for the future growth of Brunei's digital economy," said Heiko Trost, Chief Digital Officer of UNN, at the signing ceremony. "We view this relationship with Vobile as far more than a conventional customer-provider engagement. We see it as a partnership built on shared ambition, innovation and mutual success. Together, we have the opportunity to create meaningful value for Brunei, strengthen the nation's digital capabilities, and explore new opportunities across the region."

"DreamMaker helps film and television studios, independent producers and creators use AI technologies to create video entertainment while protecting their intellectual property and finding new ways to generate revenue from their work. This is especially important as AI transforms the global creative industry," said Ben Smith, Executive Vice President of Vobile. "By combining UNN's infrastructure with Vobile's AI capabilities, we can help establish Brunei as a leading AI economy in Southeast Asia while delivering sustainable economic growth for the nation."

UNN's new AI-capable data center, designed with liquid cooling and high power density to support NVIDIA's latest GPU systems, will allocate 25MW of capacity to Vobile. An additional 25MW is reserved for Vobile's future expansion. This enables Vobile to run AI factories that scale its DreamMaker platform and related services to meet growing demand from clients including film and television studios, independent producers, and content creators.

About Vobile

Vobile is the global leader in digital content protection and transaction services, trusted by the world's premier entertainment companies, platforms, music labels, sports leagues, and publishers. Using AI technologies, Vobile's solutions make creative content more valuable. Founded in Silicon Valley, Vobile has operations across North America, Asia, Australia, and Europe. For more information, visit www.vobile.com.

Contact:

Vobile

PR@vobile.com

  • New Open Model AI Inference Engine with Fast Text & Vector Storage: Executes AI inline with content distribution and streaming, allowing any frame or video-level model to execute directly in the Fabric distribution pipeline, with inference metadata instantly available globally to the Fabric's just-in-time media pipeline

BERKELEY, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Eluvio today announced that it will showcase major new advances in its Universal & Dynamic Video Intelligence architecture and Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE) at IBC Show 2026, introducing an expanded open-model AI inference engine, 17 built-in AI models and processors, fast text and vector storage, new live sports intelligence and vertical video capabilities, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) API for agentic orchestration across live events and title libraries.

Eluvio AI is the first commercially available architecture to run frame-accurate, multimodal AI analysis and inference inline within the streaming media generation and distribution pipeline itself. AI models operate directly against live and on-demand video as it flows through the Content Fabric, producing fully time-aligned labels, embeddings, vectors, transcripts, and metadata that are immediately available to the Fabric's just-in-time media pipeline.

Unlike conventional cloud AI workflows that require video to be copied, moved into separate AI processing infrastructure, analyzed, stored again, and frequently re-transcoded to produce derivatives, Eluvio performs the entire workflow in place. There are zero file copies, zero media or metadata movement, and zero re-transcoding across analysis, metadata generation, personalization, derivative creation, and delivery.

The result is a single architecture in which AI intelligence can immediately drive the video itself — enabling frame-accurate search, personalization, clipping, highlights, vertical video, compliance reels, summaries, and other derivative experiences for both live and on-demand content. Eluvio will demonstrate these capabilities live at IBC Show 2026.

"Eluvio AI is fundamentally different from point AI solutions because the intelligence runs inline, with frame accuracy, across live and archival content — without the cost and delay of copying and re-transcoding media before it can be processed and ensembling the power of individual models with frame-accuracy," said Michelle Munson, CEO and co-founder of Eluvio. "The AI is built directly into the video pipeline of the Content Fabric, rather than added afterward as a separate cloud workflow. Everything from identifying action, players, celebrities, speakers, or brands to turning that intelligence into highlights, vertical videos, compliance reels, or personalized content happens in place against the source media and has no limits on size, duration, or ensemble scale. The result is dramatically greater efficiency and speed, while making AI intelligence immediately actionable for personalization and monetization. At IBC, we're excited to show broadcasters and rights holders these capabilities running across both live sports and premium content."

Universal & Dynamic Video Intelligence Architecture

At the foundation of the new capabilities is Eluvio's Universal & Dynamic Video Intelligence Architecture, which integrates AI inference, multimodal intelligence, text and vector storage, search, generation, and agentic orchestration directly into the Content Fabric media pipeline. Its key capabilities include:

  • Frame-Accurate & Multimodal Intelligence — Video, Audio, Text, Images, Pose & Telemetry: Inference operates at frame and segment level across video, audio, text, images, pose, and multidimensional telemetry. Because the intelligence is generated against the underlying media timeline, no secondary metadata alignment step is required.
  • Zero-Copy, Zero-Movement AI: Models execute directly against Content Fabric media parts. Media does not need to be exported into separate AI pipelines, and resulting intelligence is written directly back into the Fabric where it is immediately available for search, personalization, generation, and distribution.
  • Real-Time Inline Inference for Live and VoD: AI reads live content parts as they are published and writes frame-accurate intelligence back in real time, enabling the same architecture to operate across live sports, live broadcasts, and on-demand libraries.
  • AI-Driven Just-in-Time Media: AI metadata becomes directly actionable by the Content Fabric's just-in-time media pipeline, allowing intelligence generated at a specific frame, shot, beat, scene, player, speaker, or event to dynamically control clipping, composition, personalization, transformation, and delivery.

New Open Model AI Inference Engine, 17 Built-In Models & Fast Text/Vector Storage

Eluvio's expanded AI inference engine provides an open runtime for frame-level, video-level, multimodal, and language models, allowing new open-source, Eluvio-developed, customer-specific, and third-party models to be incorporated without changing the underlying media workflow or moving the media. The platform now includes 17 built-in models and processors spanning multimodal analysis, segmentation, summarization, transcription, identification, search, and generation. Capabilities include:

  • Frame and Video-Level Inference: Models can operate against intra-coded frames, randomly sampled frames, segments, shots, scenes, or entire videos.
  • Shot, Beat & Scene Segmentation: Expanded temporal analysis identifies meaningful structural boundaries within content, providing the foundation for search, summarization, clipping, and composition.
  • Multimodal Embeddings: OpenCLIP, ImageBind, Eluvio-enhanced MediaPipe, and other models support image, video, audio, text, and pose intelligence.
  • Motion, Focus & Identity Analysis: New capabilities include custom motion identification, expert focus tracking, speaker detection and identification, celebrity identification, and player identification.
  • Multi-Language Transcription: Speech-to-text produces time-aligned transcripts that can be combined with speaker recognition and other visual intelligence.
  • Fast Text, Tag & Vector Storage: Model outputs, tags, embeddings, and associated metadata are stored directly within the Fabric and made globally available for immediate search, retrieval, inference, personalization, and generation.
  • Extensible Runtime API: Custom, open-source, and third-party models can be added continuously as the state of the art evolves, without redesigning workflows or creating separate copies of the underlying media.
  • Private Ground Truth & Model Configuration: Customers can create and manage proprietary ground-truth datasets and deploy custom models trained against their own labeled content within the Content Fabric's tenant-isolated security model.

Newest Models & Agentic Processors for Live Sports and Premium Video

At IBC, Eluvio will demonstrate a new generation of models and processors that turn AI analysis directly into actionable media outputs. For live sports, these capabilities include just-in-time vertical video generation combining live motion analysis, expert focus tracking, and per-player jersey identification. The system dynamically determines the focal point for each shot and produces 9:16 vertical presentations from a live 16:9 source — without creating a second encoded video stream or pre-generating separate vertical assets. Additional new processors include:

  • "In This Video" Key Moment Identification: Automatically identifies the most important moments within a title, event, segment, or scene.
  • Personalized Synopsis & Summarization: Generates configurable synopses and summaries for individual segments or complete titles and events, tailored by purpose, length, and style.
  • Live and On-Demand Highlights: Combines AI analysis with play-by-play, player and ball tracking, audio intelligence, and existing metadata to identify and compose personalized highlights.
  • Automatic Chapters & Segmentation: Generates chapter boundaries, labels, and descriptions using shot, beat, scene, topic, mood, and semantic analysis.
  • Zero-Copy Generative Composition: Highlights, trailers, shorts, social clips, compliance reels, and other compositions are represented as references to the original media rather than newly rendered files.
  • Natural-Language Personalization: Agentic processors can use natural-language prompts to control the purpose, content, length, style, and audience of generated outputs.

Next-Generation EVIE and EVIE Titles & Events

The Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE) provides the media-facing application layer for this intelligence, allowing users to inspect, search, validate, edit, and act upon AI data while remaining synchronized to the underlying video. The new EVIE Titles & Events experience brings the complete AI stack together around a title — such as a film or television program — or an event, such as a live sports match. New and expanded capabilities include:

  • AI Runtime: A new inference-management environment for selecting, running, and managing AI models and processors against content.
  • Media-Synchronized AI Visualization: Model outputs are organized as synchronized tracks against the media timeline and can be viewed at frame, shot, beat, scene, segment, title, or event level.
  • Deep Multimodal Search: Search across entire content libraries using natural language, images, text, music, metadata, and visual regions to identify matching shots, scenes, clips, or individual frames.
  • Ground-Truth Management: Expanded tools allow media professionals to review and correct AI results and manage private ground truth, including celebrity, speaker, and other identity data.
  • Analyze: Combine transcription, speaker recognition, motion and scene analysis, topics, moods, themes, pose, telemetry, celebrities, brands, and other intelligence within a single synchronized environment.
  • Highlight & Compose: Generate personalized sports highlights, chapter reels, trailers, shorts, compliance reels, and social compositions without duplicating the underlying source media.
  • Dynamic Vertical Video: Automatically identify focal points and crop coordinates shot-by-shot and generate dynamic 9:16 video directly from 16:9 live or on-demand sources through the Fabric's just-in-time pipeline.

New MCP API for Agentic Video Orchestration

Eluvio is also introducing a Model Context Protocol (MCP) API exposing major Content Fabric and Eluvio AI functions for agentic orchestration, allowing ChatGPT, Claude, other LLMs, third-party applications, and agentic systems to execute complex video workflows through natural-language interfaces.

A single agentic workflow can invoke models, analyze content, update vector indices, search video, generate transcriptions, identify key moments, create chapters and highlights, and produce social-ready clips, trailers, shorts, and other compositions. Because the underlying APIs operate directly against Fabric content, these agentic workflows retain the same zero-copy architecture and Content Fabric authorization model. Media remains secured within its tenant and owner-controlled permissions while agents operate against authorized functions and intelligence.

Separately, Eluvio today announced full details of the Global Broadcast Fabric, the newest Content Fabric version spanning broadcast distribution, D2C OTT streaming and monetization, and inline AI video intelligence in a companion press release 

Eluvio at IBC Show 2026

During IBC Show 2026 at the RAI Amsterdam, Eluvio will demonstrate Eluvio AI, EVIE, live sports intelligence, agentic video workflows, and the full capabilities of the Content Fabric in Hall 8, Stand 8.MS5, and in the Future Tech Zone, Hall 14, Stand 14.A58, September 11–14, 2026.

On Thursday, September 10, Eluvio execs will be present at Eluvio's table at the SVGE Europe Summit at De Hallen Studio. On Friday, September 11 from 7:30-10:30 am, Michelle Munson will speak on the "Where does the Signal Go Next" broadcast transition executive breakfast at the Traveler within the RAI. On Saturday, September 12 at 1:00 pm, Eluvio founders Michelle Munson and Serban Simu will deliver a keynote deep dive at the Eluvio stand. On Sunday, September 13 from 2pm-2:15 pm Michelle Munson will present "Beyond Cloud and Satellite: The New Architecture for Broadcast" on the Future Tech Zone stage in Hall 14.

Registration for one-on-one meetings and information about Eluvio's on-site keynote demonstrations at IBC is available at ibc.eluv.io.

About Eluvio

Eluvio is solving the generational problems of video over the Internet with its Content Fabric Protocol — transforming the distribution and monetization of premium video and digital media in contrast to legacy cloud workflows and CDNs. Eluvio serves Amazon Studios/MGM, Cricket Australia, European Professional Club Rugby, SONY, Telstra Broadcast Services, UEFA, United Rugby Championship, Warner Bros., WPALiveTV, WWE, and others.Led by Michelle Munson and Serban Simu, founders and inventors of Aspera, Eluvio is based in Berkeley, California. Eluvio holds 15 issued U.S. patents and has won multiple NAB Streaming Product of the Year awards, the Seicon Grand Prize, the Hollywood Professional Association Engineering Excellence Award, and other industry honors.

• Broadcast Transformation: Global Broadcast Fabric replaces satellite and legacy cloud for live broadcast feed distribution — sub-500ms global latency, sub-millisecond jitter, SMPTE 2022-7 decentralized multipath, fast global stream switching and failover, and instant replay — with end-to-end security, no egress fan-out charges, no internal transit charges, and no fees for unused distribution time

  • Eluvio at IBC Show 2026: Hall 8, Stand 8.MS5, and the Future Tech Zone, Hall 14, Stand 14.A58, September 11–14, 2026, RAI Amsterdam

BERKELEY, Calif., Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Eluvio today announced new advanced features to be showcased at IBC 2026 in its Global Broadcast Fabric, the latest generation of the Content Fabric protocol and global infrastructure, providing comprehensive broadcast transformation from satellite, direct-to-consumer (D2C) OTT streaming and full-stack monetization, and inline AI video intelligence. To schedule a meeting or learn full details about Eluvio's presence at the show visit https://ibc.eluv.io.

"Across the industry, broadcast distribution and D2C streaming are still largely separate tech stacks, and now everyone's bolting AI on as a third," said Michelle Munson, CEO and Co-founder, Eluvio. "The Global Broadcast Fabric supersedes these point hypervisor and CDN solutions and provides a highly efficient and simple solution that unlocks media re-use, deterministic low latency distribution, and AI personalization end-to-end. We've taken advantage of the Content Fabric's zero-copy distribution architecture, frame-accurate metadata, and inline JIT processing to eliminate the cost, complexity, and bottlenecks in advanced media distribution."

Broadcast Transformation: Replacing Satellite and Legacy Cloud Distribution

During the recent World Cup, Eluvio powered a successful commercial pilot with a Tier 1 broadcaster to provide VIP access to live streams and zero-copy VoD rewatch of 105 World Cup matches, surpassing all latency benchmarks, and outperforming the best-case broadcast and streaming latency performance, 15-45+ seconds faster than the legacy streaming services tested worldwide.

At IBC, Eluvio will demonstrate the Global Broadcast Fabric's live broadcast distribution architecture — a decentralized, zero-copy system that replaces satellite distribution, fiber point-to-point connections, and ground-to-cloud multi-point egress for live broadcast feed distribution, extended with new live-operations and monetization capabilities. One decentralized Content Fabric distribution simultaneously serves every downstream taker just-in-time — B2B broadcast affiliates and D2C consumer endpoints — from a single ingest workflow without duplication.

  • Global Broadcast Fabric with Zero-Copy & No Egress Fan-Out Charges: The decentralized any-to-any routing architecture replaces point-to-point links for no traffic duplication at scale. Cost does not increase with receiver count and performance does not degrade as receiver count grows. There are no internal Fabric transit charges and no fees for unused distribution time — delivering satellite-beating economics with over-the-top flexibility.
  • Broadcast Quality: Sub-500ms global latency with sub-millisecond jitter and SMPTE 2022-7 decentralized multipath phase-lock synchronization — broadcast-grade determinism delivered over-the-top, without centralized control or single points of failure. It's the first such capability delivered over IP at global scale.
  • Live Operations/Fast Global Switching & Instant Replay: Via the new Live Stream Manager and APIs, operators can instantly remap broadcast outputs to ingest sources and recover from failures with fast global stream switching and failover. All feeds have zero-copy recording and provide fast DVR and instant replay.
  • In-Fabric Ad Insertion: Native server-side ad insertion (SSAI) with unlimited per-session personalization, enabling ad-supported monetization directly within the distribution pipeline — no third-party ad decisioning infrastructure required.
  • Personalized Virtual Signage in Live Sports at Scale: The fabric metadata carries AI inference applied on source feeds, and executes per-frame rendering engines to apply virtual signage overlays and smart transformations per frame, for just-in-time zero-copy output generation (broadcast TS or consumer streaming). The live feed distribution requirements are constant, independent of the number of variants produced, and all media parts are re-used, making personalized virtual signage possible at scale. 

At IBC, Eluvio and uniqFEED will preview an integrated virtual signage solution for live sports applying frame accurate virtual signage just-in-time per audience group. The original program feed is analyzed once by an AdAPT Analyzer and the extracted metadata is published into Eluvio's Content Fabric as metadata on the Fabric's live stream distribution. Upon a client streaming request, a Content Fabric node executes the AdAPT Renderer inline its just-in-time, frame-level A/V stack to produce a targeted program feed. The ad image is also available to the A/V stack as Content Fabric "parts", as it is also hosted and distributed by the Fabric.  By combining metadata, program feed and received ads via Fabric JIT distribution, a dedicated feed can be created for any viewer at any time. The architecture allows for a high degree of non-intrusive targeting without modification of the player of the viewer and without duplicating the distribution. 

  • Flexible Ingest: JPEG-XS, AVC/HEVC over UDP/RTP/SRT; Ingest from cameras, encoders, and broadcast trucks on-site, or via SRT for wide-area contribution — extending to any sporting venue or remote location.
  • End-to-End Security & Authorization: Multi-layer AES encryption with proxy re-encryption into per-session key spaces; Per-session authorization enforces availability windows, geo-restrictions, ACLs, and entitlements automatically for both B2B SRT/TS and D2C HLS/DASH endpoints. Multi-DRM for D2C, SRT encryption for B2B — all built in.
  • Live Stream Manager: API-driven operational control for inputs, outputs, routing, health and QoS dashboards, multilayer statistics, and batch configuration for tens or hundreds of feeds simultaneously, with a full SDK for partner automation.
  • VIP Command Center / Single Pane of Glass: Desktop and mobile browser application for unlimited global multiview of live feeds at ultra-low latency, with brandable SSO, Fabric policy-enforced stream visibility, and built-in access controls for VIP, NOC, and remote production operations.

Direct-to-Consumer OTT Streaming, Full-Stack Monetization & New White Label Media Wallet & Pocket TV

The Content Fabric is powering thousands of D2C live games and streaming events and hosts hundreds of thousands of live, archive, and library titles for premium brands and creators — with 10x cost savings over legacy CDN and media cloud infrastructure at scale. New features include:

  • Performance and Scale: 8x increase in live stream cross-variant serving; <=30ms segment delivery latency; up to 4x scale of DRM encryption variants; zero-impact global maintenance; and instant-on HFR streaming.
  • Premium Next-Gen Video Formats: Stereoscopic HFR 4K (SBS and MV-HEVC), Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, HDR/HDR10+, full Widevine parameterization, AV1 (upcoming), optimized asset structure for hundreds of language and subtitle tracks.
  • Best in Class White Label OTT Media Wallet UX: Powered by new Media Wallet v3 and Creator Studio CMS — Eluvio provides best-in-class TV, browser, and mobile native white label D2C OTT properties with advanced UX branding, interactive experiences, and configurable live, VOD and clip based content presentation and management.  
  • Superior Viewing & Device Support: Configure and deploy unlimited D2C OTT streaming and archive monetization apps for TV/mobile/browser, B2B portals, and Pocket TV microsites with fast multi-view, integrated DVR, automatic live and VoD content slating, and up-next autoplay. New multi-view sidebar, "In This Video" AI data panel, and expanded entertainment and sports layout options provide a flexible and outstanding UX experience for fans with no code deployment. Fully integrated with the Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE), browse and publish zero-copy EVIE clips and compositions.
  • Studio-Grade Monetization: Full SVOD/TVOD (rental and ownership) entitlements, match-based live entitlements, seamless JWT/SSO, and fully integrated Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Stripe in a single checkout flow. CableLabs-compliant Title Metadata API with territory-based offers and delta-only global updates.
  • Pocket TV: A fully white-labeled microsite for live and episodic content sales with zero friction: no login required, single-click Apple Pay and Google Pay, and magic links for return access. No PII collected. Instantly embeddable as a URL in any social post, paid ad, or CRM email. Deployed by a Tier 1 US broadcast network in 2026.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Real-time analytics spanning B2B SRT/TS and D2C HTTP streams; global receiver map with per-receiver performance stats; expanded audience metrics; client-side QoS stats; and sales transaction reporting by currency, product, and country.

Eluvio AI & EVIE: Inline, Frame-Accurate Video Intelligence

Complementing the Content Fabric is a major architecture for universal dynamic video intelligence: Eluvio AI and the Eluvio Video Intelligence Editor (EVIE). Eluvio AI is the first commercially available inline, frame-accurate, multimodal AI built natively into a media platform — running inference on live and VOD content at frame and segment level with zero file copies, zero file movement, and zero transcoding, across open-source, custom, and third-party models. Full details were announced in a companion press release issued separately today.

During IBC Show 2026 at the RAI Amsterdam, Eluvio will showcase solutions chosen by Tier 1 content owners across broadcast, D2C, and AI, including live sport transformation case studies with and others, in Hall 8, Stand 8.MS5, and the Future Tech Zone, Hall 14, Stand 14.A58, September 11–14, 2026.

On Saturday, September 12 at 1:00 pm, Eluvio founders Michelle Munson and Serban Simu will deliver a keynote deep dive at the Eluvio stand. On Sunday, September 13 from 2pm-2:15 pm Michelle Munson will present "Beyond Cloud and Satellite: The New Architecture for Broadcast" on the Future Tech Zone stage in Hall 14.

Registration for one-on-one meetings and information about Eluvio's on-site keynote demonstrations at IBC is available at ibc.eluv.io.

releases.title: Comcast Technology Solutions Unveils Next-Gen Video AI Applications for Broadcasters, Content and Streaming Providers, and Operators
releases.body:
• Building on CTS' VideoAI™ platform, new suite of end-to-end AI-powered workflow applications brings premium content processing capabilities to manage and monetize entire content libraries



  • Applications include video verticalization, localization, smart chapters, metadata enrichment, quality control, and intelligent clip generation



  • Designed to work across CTS' portfolio, including Comcast Media360™, Comcast Sports360™, and standalone Cloud Video Platform deployments

DENVER, Sept. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- In advance of the 2026 IBC Show, Comcast Technology Solutions (CTS) today unveiled a comprehensive suite of end-to-end AI-powered workflow applications for broadcasters, content owners, and operators worldwide. Building on the foundation of CTS' VideoAI™ platform, these new applications deliver AI as practical, integrated solutions to real-world content production and management challenges.

In a market increasingly crowded with standalone AI vendors and start-ups, CTS aims to serve as a single, trusted partner for end-to-end AI-enhanced content processing, video management, and monetization — backed by the proven reliability and scale of Comcast Technology Solutions and 24/7 managed services. CTS provides end-to-end, production-ready workflow integration that embeds AI capabilities into complete, deployable applications — requiring no additional specialist AI knowledge or developer requirements. The new applications are designed to work across CTS' full product portfolio, including Comcast Media360™ for broadcasters and content owners, Comcast Sports360™ for sports rights holders, and standalone deployments of CTS' Cloud Video Platform (CVP) for operators.

"The video industry is ready to move past AI hypotheticals and onto production-ready applications that solve real problems, generate new business opportunities, and integrate seamlessly into the workflows they already rely upon," said Bart Spriester, Senior Vice President and General Manager of Streaming, Broadcast, and Advertising at Comcast Technology Solutions. "Whether for creating vertical videos, localization, advanced advertising, metadata enrichment, quality control, or intelligent clip generation, CTS stands ready to help our customers benefit from AI to better manage and monetize their content catalogs. CTS VideoAI is based on implementations deployed by some of the world's largest media companies, and we're excited to roll out this package of new applications designed to help our customers of all sizes benefit from that experience in new ways."

Next-Gen AI Applications 

The next-gen AI applications from CTS include:

  • Video Verticalization: Using AI-driven smart cropping technology, CTS can automatically convert landscape video content into portrait format for social media syndication, intelligently identifying the "action center" of each scene and making intelligent cut or pan decisions without manual editor intervention. 
  • Localization of Regional Languages: Leveraging AI-generated voices, CTS can automate dubbing workflows that previously required costly and time-consuming human voice talent. The application can extract audio from soundtracks, preserve ambience and music, translate dialogue, select appropriate voice matching, relay the finished audio back into the content, and generate automated captions. 
  • Smart Chapters: For distribution-ready workflows combining content and ad insertion, CTS can create AI-driven detection of intros, credit rolls, and ad break candidates, enhanced with weighting algorithms to select the optimal set of ad break points and automatically trigger stream conditioning, transcoding, and packaging. 
  • Metadata Enrichment: CTS will automatically generate scene and asset-level metadata and pass it into Cloud Video Platform metadata files, enabling semantic and natural language search capabilities. Rather than traditional keyword searches, content owners will be able to unlock intent-based discovery, allowing customers to find content based on themes, moods, and contextual queries. 
  • Automated Quality Control: CTS will also offer AI-powered "virtual eyes-on-glass" QC checks — including black screen detection, missing audio identification, and other content integrity verifications. This capability can enable cost-effective QC across a significantly larger portion of the content catalog compared to traditional human monitoring approaches. 
  • Intelligent Clipping: CTS will also offer natural language query-driven clip identification and selection, allowing editors to find key moments within long-form content. This could include sports highlights, social media clips, or trailer generation, and then trigger automated processing and publishing workflows.

CTS' new applications are integrated into CTS' Cloud Media Processing (CMP) engine, a flexible, programmable workflow orchestration layer. Processors can be inserted as pre-processors, content manipulation steps, or post-processors, enabling customers to activate individual AI capabilities within their existing workflows without rebuilding their technology stack. For broadcasters and content owners using Comcast Media360, the AI-enhanced workflow processors integrate with existing channel origination and content supply chain services. For sports organizations leveraging Comcast Sports360, capabilities such as intelligent clipping and metadata enrichment are directly applicable to live and on-demand sports content workflows. For MVPDs and operators, these applications will be made available through CTS' Cloud Video Platform. Each of these applications is expected to be made commercially available throughout 2026-2027 to support customer deployments.

Comcast Technology Solutions at IBC 2026

At the 2026 IBC Show, CTS will showcase its next-gen video AI capabilities and full suite of solutions for streaming, broadcast, entertainment, and sports at RAI Amsterdam, September 11–14 in Hall 5, Stand 5.C80. Experts will be on hand to demonstrate the new AI applications and discuss how they integrate across the Comcast Media360, Comcast Sports360, and Cloud Video Platform portfolios. Customers, prospects, and partners of CTS seeking to schedule on-site business meetings can visit: https://www.comcasttechnologysolutions.com/events.

To learn more about Comcast Technology Solutions' entire product portfolio, visit: https://www.comcasttechnologysolutions.com.

About Comcast Technology Solutions

Comcast Technology Solutions, a division of one of the world's leading media and technology companies, brings Comcast Corporation's proven technologies to an evolving list of industries worldwide. Comcast Technology Solutions offers a broad portfolio of solutions that deliver flexibility at scale for global video, media, communications, data applications, and cybersecurity & compliance. Customers include leading content and streaming video providers, pay TV operators and MVPDs, advertisers, communications providers, financial service providers, retailers, and more. For more information, visit Comcast Technology Solutions.

releases.title: Actus Digital Unveils the Future of Broadcast Monitoring at IBC2026
releases.body:
Next-generation Actus X introduces workflow-focused UX, customizable browser-based multiviewer, AI-based content monitoring and planned native LiveU LRT™ integration

HACKENSACK, N.J., Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Actus Digital, a LiveU company, will unveil the next generation of its Actus X platform at IBC2026 on LiveU's Stand 7.C24, demonstrating how broadcasters can simplify operations, respond faster to technical and content issues, and adapt confidently to rapidly changing workflows.

Visitors will experience the established capabilities that have made Actus X a trusted solution worldwide – compliance logging, QA and technical monitoring, browser-based multiviewing, clip creation and AI-powered media intelligence – alongside major advances in usability, performance, scalability and integration.

As media operations expand across linear, OTT and digital platforms, broadcasters must monitor more channels, formats and delivery points, often with distributed teams and shifting requirements. The latest evolution of Actus X addresses this through workflow-focused user experiences, intelligent automation, flexible deployment and deeper integration across the LiveU EcoSystem.

"Broadcast operations are becoming more dynamic, distributed and complex, but the technology supporting them should become simpler," said Sima Levy, CEO of Actus Digital. "The next generation of Actus X is designed around the people who use it every day, giving each team the visibility, flexibility and intelligence it needs to work faster and make better decisions."

Rebuilt for Dynamic Operations

The new Actus X infrastructure has been rebuilt using advanced software technologies for faster performance, greater scalability and enhanced cloud efficiency. System configuration is now significantly more dynamic: as a channel changes resolution, a new service launches or additional capacity is needed, adjustments can be made quickly without complex engineering work. This flexibility is especially valuable for temporary services, live events and fast changing broadcast environments.

A Next-Generation Browser-Based Multiviewer

Actus will also showcase its next-generation browser-based multiviewer, built for distributed, personalized monitoring. Each user can create unlimited layouts via drag-and-drop, selecting the channels, alerts and technical information relevant to their role – no longer restricted to fixed layouts or dedicated monitoring stations. Because it runs entirely within a browser, it can be securely accessed from virtually anywhere, with sub-second latency for real-time monitoring.

The experience goes beyond passive viewing. Operators can listen to live audio, rewind content instantly, investigate alerts and interact directly with monitored streams, all from one interface, with integrated alerts enabling faster response and less manual supervision.

Cloud-Optimized Without Compromising Choice

Actus has invested extensively in optimizing Actus X for cloud environments, improving resource efficiency and helping customers control infrastructure costs. Actus X continues to support on-premises, cloud-native and hybrid architectures, so organizations can choose and evolve the model that fits their operational, technical, security and regulatory needs.

Direct connection between content acquisition and monitoring 

At IBC2026, Actus will also present its roadmap for deeper integration with LiveU native LRT, led by planned native support for LiveU Reliable Transport (LRT™) within Actus X. This will allow LiveU feeds to be ingested directly into Actus X benefiting from all Actus monitoring and AI capabilities, without first converting them to another protocol – reducing latency, eliminating unnecessary points of failure, and preserving original video quality, and LRT's bonding and error-resilience advantages throughout the workflow. For customers, that means fewer gateway components and a more direct connection between content acquisition and monitoring.

A User Experience Designed Around Every Workflow

One of the most significant developments is a completely redesigned interface structured around specific operational roles. Instead of showing every user the same screens, Actus X provides focused workspaces for broadcast engineers, technical operators, compliance teams, production staff and media intelligence professionals – each with immediate access to the tools, data and alerts most relevant to their responsibilities.

For engineers, a dedicated technical workspace brings critical information onto a single screen, with multiple channels and delivery points viewable simultaneously to help teams identify anomalies, investigate their source and respond before viewers are affected – a cleaner experience and a faster route from detection to resolution.

Actus Digital will be presenting Actus X on LiveU's Stand 7.C24. For more information or to schedule a demonstration, visit https://www.liveu.tv/products/manage/actus-digital.

About Actus Digital

Since 2005, and now in a bigger capacity as a LiveU company, Actus Digital has set the standard for intelligent media monitoring and compliance logging, trusted by broadcasters, media regulators, public sector organizations, and governments. With over 2,000 installations, Actus delivers a QA Compliance Logger enhanced with advanced solutions like Actus SW based multiviewer, Actus AI Media Insight for content analysis, Clip Factory Pro for content repurposing, OTT StreamWatch for OTT/FAST monitoring and Actus Remote post-STB Video monitoring (RVM). Each product can stand alone or be fully integrated into one unified platform.

Actus supports all broadcast video and streaming protocols and is available as a turnkey appliance, software/VM-based system, or SaaS. Headquartered in the US with global 24/7 support, Actus Digital, now a LiveU company, is accelerating innovation and delivering even greater value to customers.

For more details, please visit https://www.liveu.tv/products/manage/actus-digital, or follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, or YouTube.

releases.title: Hollyland to Unveil New Solutions for Live Production and Content Creation at IBC 2026
releases.body:
Highlights

  • Hollyland to showcase new solutions for professional live production and content creation at IBC 2026 Booth 11.C28.
  • Pyro 7 Ultra combines professional monitoring and wireless video transmission in one monitor.
  • Argus X1 brings switching, recording, monitoring, and streaming into one live production system.
  • Solidcom C1 Air and Solidcom SE 2 expand Hollyland's wireless intercom lineup.
  • New creator solutions include the LARK A2 and LARK M3 wireless microphones and the VenusLiv Air 2 streaming camera.

AMSTERDAM, Aug. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hollyland, a global provider of professional wireless audio and video solutions, is set to introduce new solutions for professional live production and modern content creation at IBC 2026. From September 11 to 14, 2026, the company will showcase its expanded ecosystem at Booth 11.C28 in the RAI Amsterdam convention center, where visitors can explore its newest technologies and products scheduled for release later in 2026.

Expanding Live Production Portfolio

Hollyland continues to expand its product range with new solutions for professional production and content creation. At IBC 2026, the company will introduce new solutions for professional live production, designed to help production teams work more efficiently, reliably, and seamlessly in demanding environments. The new lineup includes the Pyro 7 Ultra professional wireless monitor, Argus X1 all-in-one live production switcher, and Solidcom C1 Air and Solidcom SE 2 intercom systems.

The Pyro 7 Ultra, launching on September 3, brings professional monitoring and wireless video transmission together in one 7-inch monitor. Professional productions have traditionally relied on separate wireless transmission systems and standalone field monitors, with additional cables between devices and separate power sources for each device. The Pyro 7 Ultra can serve as an on-camera monitor and transmitter, or as a handheld monitor and receiver for mobile viewing. Its QD-LCD display delivers exceptional color accuracy, with each unit factory-calibrated via Calman® to achieve a ΔE <1.5. Users can also recalibrate the display with the Hollyland Color Calibrator to maintain color accuracy over time. The system also offers 20ms latency, 1km transmission, unlimited receivers, 4K60 video transmission, and TWiFi technology.

Also debuting is Argus X1, an all‑in‑one live production switcher slated for release in December. Argus X1 consolidates switching, monitoring, recording, streaming, and content delivery into a single device. A 10.1‑inch FHD touchscreen provides intuitive control, while 4K60 video I/O and support for three Hollyland wireless transmitters expand its flexibility across multi‑camera workflows. Built‑in streaming, ISO recording, MultiView, and connectivity options including Wi‑Fi 6, 4G, and Gigabit Ethernet make Argus X1 a central hub within the Hollyland production ecosystem.

Two new intercom systems will also be introduced during the event. Solidcom C1 Air features an open‑ear design, a 42g headset, 300m wireless range, and dual‑microphone ENC for clean dialogue. Solidcom SE 2 adds intelligent frequency hopping, a 123g build, 20 dB ENC, 3.5mm audio I/O, and up to 10 hours of runtime, delivering stable performance for field and studio teams.

Empowering Modern Content Creation

Hollyland is also expanding its creator‑focused audio lineup with several new tools designed for modern podcasting and production. LARK A2, arriving in early September, offers 48 kHz/24‑bit recording, three‑level AI noise cancellation, a 200m range, and an 8.5g transmitter. Quick charging, AI power saving, intuitive controls, and a –6 dB safety track support dependable on‑the‑go capture.

Launching on September 22, the LARK M3 introduces flexible multi‑person recording with support for four transmitters and four receivers. It provides four‑track independent recording, 48 kHz/32‑bit float audio, vocal presets, 300m transmission and up to eight hours of use on a single charge. The LARK M3 is well suited for podcasts, interviews, video conversations, and multi-person content creation.

Rounding out the lineup, the VenusLiv Air 2 will arrive in November with 4K60 UVC streaming and SAR AI Tuning 2.0, while maintaining the core performance of the VenusLiv Air.

During IBC 2026, Hollyland will host Roll & Win giveaways from September 11–14. Visitors can participate for a chance to win Hollyland's products and other prizes. On September 11, the company will unveil its new products, followed by an anniversary celebration that evening. Meanwhile, all showcased solutions will be available for hands‑on experience at Booth 11.C28 throughout the exhibition.

About Hollyland

Hollyland is a leading provider of wireless products, specializing in wireless intercom systems, video transmission systems, monitors, wireless microphones, and live streaming cameras. Since 2013, Hollyland has been serving millions of users around the world in various fields, including filmmaking, telecasting, video production, live events, exhibitions, theaters, houses of worship, and content creation. It has built a sales network covering approximately 160 countries and regions, supported by regional teams and offices worldwide. For more information, please visit https://www.hollyland.com/, Hollyland Facebook, and Hollyland Instagram.

releases.title: DPAA Announces Initial Speakers for 14th Annual Video Everywhere Summit, With the Theme of "Real Connections"
releases.body:
Former White House Communications Director and SkyBridge Founder Anthony Scaramucci to Take the Stage on October 13, 2026, in NYC

CMOs from American Eagle Outfitters, Expedia, Hisense, Microsoft, and Major League Soccer to Speak, along with Top Leaders from Stagwell and Omnicom's Mediahub Worldwide

NEW YORK, Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DPAA, the global trade marketing association driving the growth and digitization of out-of-home (OOH) advertising, has announced the initial speaker lineup for the 14th annual Video Everywhere Summit, set for October 13, 2026, at Pier 60 at Chelsea Piers in New York City. This includes Anthony Scaramucci, former White House Communications Director, Founder & Managing Partner, SkyBridge, and author of All the Wrong Moves (Sept. 22, Macmillan); top agency leaders; and CMOs from across brand categories.

Also announced today was the theme for the 2026 DPAA Global Video Everywhere Summit: Real Connections. This comes following multiple forecasts of global DOOH revenue growth, most recently from PQ Media, which is predicting a 15.3% gain in 2026 (up from 12% growth in 2025), driven in part by major global events including the FIFA World Cup and Winter Olympics, as brands increasingly look to connect digital capabilities with real-world consumer experiences.

"Creating authentic, real connections and conversations has never been more important," said DPAA President & CEO Barry Frey. "As we espouse the impact brands can make by connecting with consumers in the real world, we must also take advantage of every face-to-face connection we are able to make. This includes the marketers controlling ad spend; the agencies shaping their media plans; and the technology, data and research organizations coming up with new ways to innovate, execute and measure the outcomes that DOOH uniquely brings."

The Summit brings approximately 1,000 industry leaders direct access to the people who influence the future of omnichannel marketing. There, they network with others in this vibrant community, discuss marketing trends, challenges and opportunities, and hear from CMOs, newsmakers, and agency executives. This includes the top marketers from brands across the consumer electronics, retail, sports and travel sectors.

Taking the stage at DPAA's October 2026 events in addition to Scaramucci include:

  • Craig Brommers, CMO, American Eagle Outfitters
  • David Sable, Vice Chairman, Stagwell
  • Jochen Koedijk, CMO, Expedia
  • Nicole Estebanell, U.S. CEO, Mediahub Worldwide (Omnicom)
  • Radika Duggal, CMO, Major League Soccer
  • Sarah Larsen, CMO, Hisense
  • Sydne Mullings, General Manager - Americas CMO, Microsoft
  • Additional speakers to be announced.

The Summit attendees each year connect and converse around key trends. This includes the growing DOOH medium, which has become a key driver of real business outcomes, real world experiences, real time buying and planning, and … real connections!

Also core to the discussions expected to take place at the Summit are how in-store retail media networks, programmatic offerings, AI-powered tools, IRL experiences around big sports and entertainment events, and improved measurement options are playing a major role in establishing and enhancing DOOH as both a launchpad of innovation and a growing part of brands and agencies' omnichannel strategies.

One day before the Summit is the DPAA Newsmakers Dinner - an annual invite-only event that takes place the evening before the Summit in NYC, and includes a broader discussion of key issues shaping the media and news landscape. In recent years, the Dinner has featured fireside chats with such notable Newsmakers as Chuck Todd (former host of Meet the Press), Jessica Tarlov (The Five), Alyssa Farah Griffin (The View, CNN), Katty Kay (BBC), Mark Bezos, and Frank Luntz. The Global Summit stage has previously hosted leaders from Colgate-Palmolive, General Motors, Mastercard, McDonald's, PepsiCo, Kroger, Danone, Warner Bros., Paramount+, H&R Block, WPP, Dentsu, Omnicom and many others.

For more information, or to register to attend the Global Summit – part of Out of Home Week New York – please visit www.dpaasummit.com/global.

About DPAA

DPAA (www.dpaaglobal.com) is the global trade marketing association, driving the growth and digitization of out-of-home (OOH) advertising and its growing role in the Omnichannel mix. Membership in the DPAA community includes many business acceleration benefits and access to a wide array of products. It offers members an extensive database of research, best practices and case studies; tools for planning, training and forecasting; social media amplification of news; insights on software and hardware solutions; and further integration into the advertising ecosystem by connecting DOOH networks, brands, agencies, ad tech and others – including through its podcast, Launchpad of Innovation. DPAA's Video Everywhere Summit, the largest one-day media/marketing event of its kind, is October 13, 2026, at Pier 60 in New York City.
